summary: A singing songwriter firmware on Dinghy: a pixel singer voices Japanese syllables over FM chords, bass and drums, with a song generator and a DX7-style FM engine.
features: Live formant voice: 73 Japanese mora, five characters, harmony voice
Four tracks (vocal, chords, bass, drums), 16 patterns of 64 rows
GEN writes whole songs in nine styles, from hyperpop to chip
Six-operator DX7 engine; import cartridges and export a 32-voice bank
USB and TRS MIDI keyboard input with sustain; 10 song slots
DX7 SysEx and MIDI input not yet tried on a real FM-1
